## Summary

What changes and why? Link the issue or proposal when relevant.

## Verification

Commands run, environments tested, and results. Explain unrun checks.

## Trust and research claims

- [ ] No credentials, real memories, or confidential logs are included.
- [ ] Host permissions cannot be set by model/tool arguments.
- [ ] Negative tests cover changed validation or authorization behavior.
- [ ] Schemas, specification, docs, and implemented behavior agree.
- [ ] Measured results and planned features are clearly distinguished.
- [ ] Third-party provenance and licensing are documented.
- [ ] AI-assisted contributions are identified and verified below, if applicable.

## Limitations

Remaining gaps, migration considerations, and AI assistance used.
